Frequently Asked Questions

Is my video uploaded to a server?

No. The sound is extracted entirely in your browser and never leaves your device.

Which videos work?

MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV, AVI and most other common video files that have a sound track.

Which quality should I pick?

192 kbps sounds great for music and speech. Choose 320 kbps for the highest quality, or 128 kbps for a smaller file.

Why does it say my video has no sound?

Some videos, like many screen recordings, are saved without a sound track, so there is nothing to convert.
